newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shohkoh Fund rises on higher dividends.
newsitem.headline: Shohkoh Fund rises on higher dividends.

text.p: Shares of Shohkoh Fund & Co Ltd rose in the over-the-counter (OTC) market on Thursday morning, supported by the firm's announcement on Wednesday that it would raise its dividends for the current business year ending January 31, 1997, traders said.
The share price of Shohkoh Fund, a financing company dealing mainly with small and medium-sized firms, was up 600 yen at 24,000 yen at 0155 GMT. Volume was 17,000 shares.
On Wednesday, Shohkoh Fund said it would boost its ordinary dividend for 1996/97 by 30 yen to 100 yen and offer a commemorative dividend of 200 yen.
